name: ankit---portfolio
description: A pixel-perfect portfolio website for **Ankit**, built with React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "API,FRONTEND,ADMIN" --prefix-colors "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix admin"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix admin
